transitions.observation: From the doorway to the reception desk. The desk, phone and registers are already visible through the door in 01-1, so the cut inside reads as the same morning.
The same desk sits in the background of 01-3, with Meera still on the call and writing. Ananya looks toward her, so 01-3 answers 01-2.

Page turn. 'Let's make the rest simpler' is followed by the caption 'The clinic begins its Welbuk onboarding.' over an office with a sunset window and Ananya typing on a laptop. The colour shift and the change of room make the time and place jump readable, and the caption answers 'how?'.

readingReview.comparison: My image-only order matches the first reader's and the script. The first reader's concerns: (1) Meera is not introduced and her role is unclear. The art resolves it: she sits behind the reception desk with the phone and registers, facing a patient queue, so she reads as the receptionist. Her name is not lettered on page 1, and the source does not letter it either. No line depends on her name, so I accept this. (2) Ananya is tiny in the establishing panel. In the art she is the clear focal figure in the doorway, in a white coat with a stethoscope, right under the caption that names Dr. Ananya. Resolved. (3) The first tail ends left of the meera box at about (297,940). In the art it lands at the top of her head and clearly belongs to her. Resolved. Nothing unresolved.
